stem:
Padma chooses a cotton shirt for a hot sunny afternoon. She wants to gain the least heat from the Sun.

Which shirt should she choose?

options.text: A black shirt, because dark colours reflect most of the heat that falls on them.
A white shirt, because light colours reflect most of the heat that falls on them.
A black shirt, even when no sunlight falls on either shirt.
A white shirt, because light colours absorb most of the heat that falls on them.

teacher.key_rationale: Light colours reflect most of the Sun's heat, so a white shirt gains less heat in summer sunlight.
